name: Driver License
definition: Official document issued by state authorities that grants individuals the legal right to operate motor vehicles.

Assigner.name: Assigner
Assigner.definition: Authority assigning an identification to a driver license.

IssuanceDate.name: Issuance Date
IssuanceDate.definition: Date of issuance of the driving license.

ExpirationDate.name: Expiration Date
ExpirationDate.definition: Expiration date of the driving license (if and when relevant).

IssuingCountrySubDivision.name: Issuing Country Sub Division
IssuingCountrySubDivision.definition: Country sub-division issuing the driver license (if and when relevant).

AlternativeAuthority.name: Alternative Authority
AlternativeAuthority.definition: Other authority issuing a driver license.

Owner.name: Owner
Owner.definition: Owner of the driving license who been granted the legal right to operate motor vehicles.
